title: Soren and the Small Bright Sound
youtube_title: Soren and the Small Bright Sound | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can be a small sound offered at the right time.
summary: Soren is unsure about playing his triangle in the town's quiet music circle. He tries the pattern just for the grass, misses a cue, tries again, and learns that a small bright sound can be enough.
